Dialogs.Dialog: I've never felt like this before...
I'm glad to be with you.
Geez... No fair, it's always you.
I like it when you do that, you know？
Let's say it's fun... for your sake.
I don't know why, but I keep smiling.
The weather's nice and I feel good.
Hey, what should we do next？
Is it okay to have this much fun？
I wish times like this could last forever.
You're doing it on purpose, aren't you？ ...Geez.
...My face is red because of you.
Only you get to do this, you know？
I'll do the same thing to you, okay？
I wish time would just stop.
I want to stay like this forever...
Hehe, stay by my side like this？
I've got you all to myself. Just kidding.
I don't dislike that kind of thing, you know？
As long as it's only me, it's fine？
Keep looking at me like that？ Only me.
Geez, what's this all of a sudden？
What's gotten into you all of a sudden？
Even from you, something like that...
Geez, I won't forgive you, okay？
What do you think I am？
Think about how the other person feels, properly.
Do it again, and I won't forgive you.
How can I make you understand？
Geez... I'll start disliking you, you know？
Hey, don't make things hard for me？
Geez！ Do you need a punishment？
I've never dyed it, you know？
I work hard taking care of my hair.
When you pet me, I get sleepy.
Can I do the same to you？
Next time just tell me？ I'll fix it myself.
Right now... I'd like you to stop that...
I'm not a kid, you know？
Hehe, are you trying to make static？
Fix it properly later. Just kidding.
I feel like a dog or a cat.
Hiding that you're shy？ Hehe, cute▼
That's a mean thing to do.
You shouldn't do things people don't like.
I worked so hard on my hair...
I don't think I have a fever...
How I feel？ I'm not sick？
It feels like I'll get a fever just where you touched.
Your hand feels nice, doesn't it？
Even close friends need manners, you know？
...Even if you apologize, I won't forgive you！
That's not enough to surprise me.
It makes me go weak, so it's banned.
Mm！ Geez, none of that. Okay？
In a place like this... Dummy.
This is nice too, isn't it？ Hehe.
Hehe, maybe I'll lean on you？
People will get the wrong idea, so stop.
That kind of thing, another time.
I'm not in the mood for that right now...
You can't do this with other girls, okay？
Holding hands with you makes me feel safe...
Fingers laced together would be nice？ Just kidding.
Why are you holding my hand？
I don't think this is good...
Aren't you hot, sticking so close？
...Could you move away just a little？
It's hot, but I'll let you stay like this a little longer.
Aren't you hot？ If you're okay with it, then fine.
Being close to you makes my heart pound... Is it the heat？
Hot, isn't it？ But I won't let go▼
It's hot, but it feels nice... Strange, isn't it？
Share some of your body heat with me？ Just kidding.
I won't be much of a windbreak, you know？
I'll hold your hand until you warm up. Just kidding.
If we stay close like this, we won't be cold, right？
If you squeeze tighter, will it get warmer？
Don't get too far away, okay？
Are you leading me by the hand？
...What are you doing, taking advantage of the confusion？
It's dark. My heart's racing a little...
If we stay right close, I feel safe, right？
Geez, I can see you, you know？
...Do you know what you just did？
Do you think you can do anything to me？
Hehe, maybe I'll rely on you？
When you make that face, I get self-conscious...
Yes, I won't leave your side.
I won't let any other girls near you▼
This is kind of nerve-racking, isn't it？ Hehe.
I can walk by myself, so don't worry？
I'd rather you didn't take it so lightly...
Not too much, um... I'm in a swimsuit.
So we don't get separated？ Okay, then.
If we do this, we won't get separated, right？
Hehe, it's nice once in a while.
Let's not let go even in the water？ Just kidding.
We're on the same wavelength. Hehe.
Why do that all of a sudden？
If you look that much, I might wear out.
I don't know why, but my heart's pounding.
This is a girlfriend's privilege, right？
I want to stay like this forever... Maybe.
Yes, this arm is reserved just for you.
Won't linking arms get in the way？
If it's just a little bit...
...Being treated like a kid once in a while might be nice.
I don't really like that... I think.
I'll keep up, so it's fine？
All of a sudden is a little... Sorry？
I'd like to rest a little...
I walk a little differently than usual.
More ladylike than usual. Just kidding.
What is it？ I don't get it.
Hey, aren't you staring a bit much？
If something's bothering you, tell me？
Let's go out together again, okay？
I think I'll sleep well tonight...
Are you soothing me because I don't want to go home？
Hehe. Can I pet you too？
I really don't want to go home...
Your hands really do feel nice.
Your hands are so gentle... I love them？
We'll see each other again, right...
Want to run away somewhere like this？ Just kidding.
...Yes. Just a little longer, like this...
What do I do. I don't want to let go...
I want to stay like this...
I want to forget all about curfew...
I don't want to let go...
Are you trying to keep me here？ ...I'm kind of happy.
And I was going to take your hand myself？ Hehe.
You like touching my hair, huh. I see...
My forehead？ Hehe, you like it here.
My ear... Yes, maybe that's nice.
Touching each other's hands... Yes, that's nice.
Touching someone's hair... is special, isn't it.
If it's you, I don't mind having my hair touched.
I love it when you touch my hair...
My forehead...？ In front of you, I can let my guard down this much...
Isn't my forehead hot？ When you touch me, it gets so...
Just having my forehead touched makes me this happy. It's because it's you...
My ears are really sensitive, so I can feel you so strongly...
My ears are getting so hot from you touching them...
Does touching ears feel good？ Hehe.
My arm... Want to link arms？ ...Okay, but don't let go without asking...
When you touch my arm, I can't resist...
My arms always want to hug you too...
Your hand holding my hand is holding my heart too...
I'm sure my hands are happiest when they're holding yours...
Hold it tighter？ So I won't forget the feeling even after we let go...
